name: FWD Group Holdings Limited
summary: FWD Group Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides life insurance products and services. The company operates through Hong Kong & Macau, Thailand & Cambodia, Japan, Emerging Markets, and Corporate and Others segments. It also offers accident and health insurance, and savings plans to customers, as well as distributes related investment and other financial service products. In addition, the company underwrites general insurance, as well as provides investment related products and services.
